name: riverstream-automation
description: Enterprise test automation framework for River Stream using Playwright and TypeScript

scripts.test:upload:sif:allure: npm run allure:clean && playwright test tests/upload/upload.spec.ts -g "TC_File Upload_007" && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:upload:sif:headed:allure: npm run allure:clean && playwright test tests/upload/upload.spec.ts -g "TC_File Upload_007" --headed && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:upload:allure: npm run allure:clean && playwright test tests/upload/upload.spec.ts && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:upload:headed:allure: npm run allure:clean && playwright test tests/upload/upload.spec.ts --headed && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:upload:batch: npm run allure:clean && playwright test tests/upload/upload.spec.ts -g "TC_File Upload_Batch" --headed && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:main: playwright test tests/auth tests/left-side tests/upload tests/documents tests/po-ack-recon tests/review tests/email
scripts.report: ts-node --transpile-only src/reporters/generate-elegant-report.ts && node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const p = require('path').resolve('playwright-report/index.html'); exec(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'start \"\" \"' + p + '\"' : 'open \"' + p + '\"');"
scripts.allure:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('allure-results')) fs.rmSync('allure-results', { recursive: true, force: true }); if (fs.existsSync('allure-report')) fs.rmSync('allure-report', { recursive: true, force: true });"
